message.content: {"label":"Positive","rationale":"The order was designated as critical, so Clause 1 entitles the customer to the penalty. The stated facts do not establish the excusable-delay condition in Clause 2: Clause 7 requires failure to send written notice, which is not shown. Although force majeure makes Clause 3 unavailable, that does not defeat Clause 1.","source_ids":["C1","C2","C3","C6","C7","F1","F2","F3","F4"]}
